cases.name: r3-replay-discards-foreign-history
cases.selectionRationale: Reject an incorrect paper-to-code recovery observation: foreign execution must participate in value replay, and the observation must apply the stored inverse receipts. This is a semantic-contract mutation, not a runtime fault. Require a fresh selected positive, complete mutant compilation and the named postcondition failure; resource exhaustion is not evidence.
